newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Resources unit wins 11 bids.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Resources unit wins 11 bids.

text.p: Equitable Resources Inc said on Tuesday that its Equitable Resources Energy Co subsidiary won 11 of 18 bids on blocks awarded by the Central Gulf of Mexico Federal Lease Sale, increasing its Gulf Coast acreage by 50 percent.
Equitable's bids totalled $4.8 million, for a 100 percent working interest in three blocks and a 50 percent working interest in eight others.
Equitable said it plans to start drilling in the first quarter of 1998.
The 33,000 acres in the blocks acquired by these bids bring Equitable's total acreage in the Gulf to 101,000 acres.
